_why: The recipe of a FLOOR of the floor model (1.58.0, docs/labyrinth/mega_v2_gen2.md): the promises one small level makes, kept as data so the pacing can be retuned without a new jar. It is the default recipe with the numbers of a floor of about 28 rooms in a region of 13 to 19 modules (the old sector had about 100 rooms in 19 x 19): every distance is shorter, there is one treasure closet to find instead of two, and at most one trial, trap and puzzle room each (they are big rooms, and a small floor with three traps would be a gauntlet). `stairMinWalk` is the least number of doorways between the arrival stairs and the forward stairs. The values below are the numbers compiled into mega.gen.Recipe.forFloors; the unit test FloorRecipeTest fails if the two drift apart. Keys that start with an underscore are comments.
